correctness.rationale: For every R>r>0 and h>0, axis cosine t=|u_3| is uniform [0,1]. Convex support of two filled end disks gives W(t)=max(2R sqrt(1-t^2),(R+r)sqrt(1-t^2)+ht). The branches meet at theta0=atan((R-r)/h), while the second has its smooth peak at alpha=atan(h/(R+r)). Direct inversion of monotone trigonometric intervals yields the stated complete CDF with A+B, no atoms. The internal cusp/peak onset occurs at h²=(R-r)(R+r); global maximum exchange when (R+r)²+h²=4R² at h²=(R-r)(3R+r); global minimum exchange when h²+(R-r)²=4R² at h²=(R+r)(3R-r). Differences are positive for proper frusta, including H3-H2=4Rr. Direct integration gives exact mean π(R+r)/4+h/2+(R-r)/2 atan((R-r)/h). Independent dense quadrature and support extrema for four frusta agreed to about 4e-6; continuum proof is analytic.
